purpose: Paired baseline vs phrase-directed original club generation; not training or musical acceptance

cases.name: house-baseline
cases.caption: Instrumental house, 124 BPM. Club music with drums, bass and synthesizers. No vocals.

cases.name: house-phrased
cases.caption: Original instrumental house, 124 BPM, warm chord stabs, syncopated bass answers, swung offbeat hats. A short DJ-friendly percussion intro, a clear rhythmic motif, an eight-bar rise, a strong bass-and-kick drop, brief contrast and a changed return. Keep the kick and bass separated, controlled low end, expressive percussion accents, purposeful fills at phrase ends and room between phrases. No vocals or spoken words.
